scenes.name: A knot forms
scenes.what: Rest; then three minutes of stress; then the stress eases to a level that is held.

scenes.name: Slow breathing
scenes.what: Thirty slow breaths, four seconds in and six out, while the stress is held.

scenes.name: Attention, no touch
scenes.what: The same thirty breaths, with attention resting on the spot.

scenes.name: A resting hand
scenes.what: A hand rests on the spot for a minute, with slow breaths; then it lifts.

scenes.name: Subtle breaths, attending
scenes.what: Small sips in and long, slow releases out, a third the size of a slow breath, with attention resting on the spot.

scenes.name: Rolling
scenes.what: A roller presses a quiet corner once every three seconds for three minutes, then stops.

scenes.name: After one lets go
scenes.what: A hand rests on the knot at the spot until it lets go (a minute at most); the slow breaths go on for ten minutes more.

scenes.name: An hour of moods
scenes.what: For an hour the stress rises and falls, as moods do.

scenes.name: Stress lingers
scenes.what: Half an hour more at the holding stress.

layout.note: a parent every 10 mm feeding four children: a small vessel every 4-5 mm

traits.label: Felt from inside
traits.text: The patch a shut vessel starves signals through its own nerve: a held, achy place, felt without touching, and a tingle as it lets go. A held, tender place, in 12 of 19 settings.
traits.depends: depends most on the oxygen debt at which a small artery's territory is tender (perforators): likelier the lower it is

depends_on.label: the oxygen debt at which a small artery's territory is tender (perforators)

traits.label: Found by a finger
traits.text: Nothing firm for a finger to find, only tenderness where it presses. Its shut artery, about 0.31 mm across and 10 mm down, is felt at about 2% of what a finger can find (at most 13%, where the fat is thinnest): nothing firm, in all 19 settings.

traits.label: Where
traits.text: Where a small artery comes up through the deep fascia, under the skin and fat, in trees: a parent with its children around it. They gather where stress is held most, in all 19 settings.
traits.cell: at the fascia, on its vessels

traits.label: How many
traits.text: Small arteries come up one every 4-5 mm: 5.0 to the square centimetre. After a stressful moment about 14 hold in this 4 cm patch (0.9 to the square centimetre); in 13 of 32 settings none can hold at all. A body has on the order of 100,000 such vessels (estimated from their spacing; 374 major ones, taylor1987).
traits.depends: depends most on width of the length–tension curve: likelier the higher it is

depends_on.label: width of the length–tension curve

traits.label: How they form
traits.text: A vessel shuts when its tone passes the fold of its switch; a parent that shuts takes its children with it. They appear within seconds of a stressful moment (the first after about 3 s), in all 19 settings.

traits.label: While stress lingers
traits.text: While the stress lingers they stay as they are, in all 19 settings.

traits.label: Pressed or rolled
traits.text: Rolling a quiet place brings none out, in 28 of 32 settings: pressure outside a vessel keeps it shut only while it lasts. In the rest it brings one out, which stays after it stops in none of 4 settings.
traits.depends: depends most on pressure a hand or roller brings to a knot: likelier the lower it is

depends_on.label: pressure a hand or roller brings to a knot

traits.label: With moods
traits.text: Over an hour of moods they hold steady, in 18 of 32 settings; some come and go in the rest.
traits.depends: depends most on width of the length–tension curve: likelier the lower it is

depends_on.label: width of the length–tension curve

traits.label: To slow breathing
traits.text: Over thirty slow breaths some let go, in 16 of 19 settings; where they do, about 80% of them, most often late in the in-breath (28% of releases), the typical one at breath 2; one within the first two breaths in 11 of 16 settings. The out-breath eases tone and the in-breath raises it again, so a knot lets go when the easing outlasts the rise.

traits.label: To attention, without touch
traits.text: With attention resting on the spot and no touch, the knot there lets go where the same breaths alone would not, or sooner, in 9 of 19 settings. Drive is not local: attention changes only how much the breath moves the tissue at the spot. If attention could aim the breath's calming at one place (a hypothesis), it would in 10 of 19 settings.
traits.depends: depends most on how far minutes of slow breathing lower stress: likelier the higher it is

depends_on.label: how far minutes of slow breathing lower stress

traits.label: To subtle breaths, attending
traits.text: With subtle breaths, a third the size of a slow breath, and attention resting on the spot, the knot there lets go in 9 of 19 settings, after about 16 s; across the patch about 14% let go (with thirty slow breaths, 74%). Small breaths move the tissue little and change drive little: what is left is attention concentrating their movement at the spot.
traits.depends: depends most on shut radius: likelier the higher it is

depends_on.label: shut radius

traits.label: What a breath would have to do
traits.text: Whatever its pattern, a breath reaches this knot through the sympathetic drive to the knot's own small artery. To free the typical knot it must fall by about 71% of the holding stress for 16 s, or 54% for a minute; nothing shorter than 16 s frees it. A slow out-breath lowers it by about 17% for a few seconds, a subtle breath by 6%, minutes of slow breathing by about 26%, sustained. So one breath frees it in none of 19 settings. Tone eases slowly when drive falls (the gasp reflex's recovery, fitted to one recording), so a calming has to last.

traits.label: Under a resting hand
traits.text: Never while the hand still presses, in all 19 settings. It lets go within seconds of the hand lifting, in 16 of 19 settings. A vessel pressed shut cannot reopen until the pressure lifts.
traits.cell: as the hand lifts (never under it)

traits.label: How it lets go
traits.text: Nothing firm to go; the tenderness fades over a minute or so. As it opens, blood floods the starved patch.
traits.cell: tenderness fades over a minute or so

traits.label: A spark
traits.text: As blood returns the vessel's nerve bursts: a tingle over the patch it feeds. 338 of the 423 releases in the breathing and hand scenes came with one, in 17 of 19 settings.

traits.label: After one lets go
traits.text: When the knot at the spot lets go, others go with it within ten seconds in all 16 settings (about 9); within ten minutes a new one holds nearby in 6 of 16 settings, and the same one holds again in none of 16 settings (the first return after about 34 s). In a tree a parent's knot shuts its children, and its release lets most of them go.
traits.cell: others go with it · one moves in nearby

traits.label: Parents and children
traits.text: Free one child under a held parent (its own drive down to rest for a minute): the child itself lets go in 5 of 18 settings, its parent in none of 18 settings, and a sibling in none of 18 settings. Free the parent instead: it lets go in 15 of 18 settings, and 2 of its 3 held children go with it (the median). Conducted dilation fades along the wall over about 2 mm (segal1989), and a child's knot sits some 4-5 mm from its parent's.
traits.cell: release runs down the tree, not up

traits.label: Held for hours
traits.text: When its stress ends, a knot held three hours lets go with it, in all 32 settings. If the wall's muscle adapts to being shut, as smooth muscle held at a new length does, an old knot outlasts its stress in 4 of 32 settings, while one held half an hour lets go in 17 of 32 settings.

traits.label: What an instrument would record
traits.text: Laser speckle over the spot sees the skin's flow rise from 0.00 to 1.44 of resting flow as it lets go (the median of 16 releases), while the sham stays at 0.92 to 0.97. A press flushes every place it presses, so the control is a pressed place with no knot.

switch.x_label: the tone of its wall (share of maximal)
switch.note: Above the band an open vessel snaps shut; once shut it stays shut until its tone falls below the band.

layout.note: small arteries in the skin and muscle, 5 mm apart, each able to latch

traits.label: Felt from inside
traits.text: Clamped, the region is cut off from awareness: a dull blind spot, hardly felt until attention or a hand brings it back, and then tender. Hardly felt, unattended, in all 32 settings.

traits.label: Found by a finger
traits.text: Nothing firm for a finger to find: what stiffens is no larger than a small artery. Its clamped artery, about 0.20 mm across and 12 mm down, is felt at about 0% of what a finger can find (at most 1%, where the fat is thinnest): nothing firm, in all 32 settings.

traits.label: Where
traits.text: Wherever smooth muscle wraps a small artery, in the skin and in the muscle beneath: regions 5 mm apart. They gather where stress is held most, in all 32 settings.

traits.label: How many
traits.text: Small arteries in the skin and muscle, each able to latch (64 representative): 4.0 to the square centimetre. After a stressful moment about 10 hold in this 4 cm patch (0.6 to the square centimetre).

traits.label: How they form
traits.text: Stress tightens a region's vessels and writes a prediction that holds them; the clamp keeps it written. They build during a stressful moment, over a minute or two (the first after about 29 s), in 25 of 32 settings.
traits.depends: depends most on how much stress tightens a region's vessels directly: likelier the higher it is

depends_on.label: how much stress tightens a region's vessels directly

traits.label: While stress lingers
traits.text: While the stress lingers they stay as they are, in all 32 settings.

traits.label: Pressed or rolled
traits.text: Rolling a quiet place brings none out, in all 32 settings: a roller brings a region into awareness for a moment, which lets a held one update, not a new one form.

traits.label: With moods
traits.text: Over an hour of moods they hold steady, in 31 of 32 settings; some come and go in the rest.

traits.label: To slow breathing
traits.text: Over thirty slow breaths some let go, in 2 of 32 settings; where they do, about 53% of them, most often late in the out-breath (43% of releases), the typical one at breath 14; one within the first two breaths in none of 2 settings. A breath lowers the stress that writes the prediction and tightens the vessels; where the clamp could not keep the prediction without it, the prediction lets go, and the latch after it.

traits.label: To attention, without touch
traits.text: With attention resting on the spot and no touch, the knot there lets go where the same breaths alone would not, or sooner, in 31 of 32 settings. Attention brings the region back into awareness, and the prediction updates.

traits.label: To subtle breaths, attending
traits.text: With subtle breaths, a third the size of a slow breath, and attention resting on the spot, the knot there lets go in 31 of 32 settings, after about 32 s; across the patch about 40% let go (with thirty slow breaths, 0%). Attention does the work; the breath's size matters little.

traits.label: What a breath would have to do
traits.text: Whatever its pattern, a breath reaches this knot through stress at the knot (a calming aimed there). No fall in it frees the typical knot, even to rest for a minute. A slow out-breath lowers it by about 17% for a few seconds, a subtle breath by 6%, minutes of slow breathing by about 28%, sustained. So one breath frees it in none of 32 settings. Calm reaches the prediction only through the stress that feeds it; awareness updates it directly.

traits.label: Under a resting hand
traits.text: It lets go under the hand, in 18 of 32 settings, after about 8 s. A hand brings the region into awareness; the prediction updates, and the latch lets go over tens of seconds.
traits.depends: depends most on a region's ordinary awareness, unattended: likelier the lower it is

depends_on.label: a region's ordinary awareness, unattended

traits.label: How it lets go
traits.text: Nothing firm to go; the tenderness fades over a minute or so. The latch relaxes slowly once its command falls.
traits.cell: tenderness fades over a minute or so

traits.label: A spark
traits.text: No spark: the latch lets go over tens of seconds, a slow warming as blood returns.

traits.label: After one lets go
traits.text: When the knot at the spot lets go, others go with it within ten seconds in 14 of 18 settings (about 2); within ten minutes a new one holds nearby in 12 of 18 settings, and the same one holds again in 10 of 18 settings (the first return after about 3 s). Each region is held by its own prediction: the ones that go with it are the ones the same hand reached. One freed under a hand that lifts too soon can come back: its vessels, still clamped, write the prediction again.
traits.cell: others go with it · one moves in nearby · it comes back

traits.label: Parents and children
traits.text: No trees: each region is held by its own prediction.

traits.label: Held for hours
traits.text: When its stress ends, a knot stays held in 8 of 32 settings, and lets go with it in the rest, over about 3 min (from 31 s to 32 min); how long it was held makes no difference. What decides it is whether the prediction's own command keeps the clamp past its halfway point once the stress has gone.
traits.depends: depends most on how much a clamped region is cut off from awareness: likelier the lower it is

depends_on.label: how much a clamped region is cut off from awareness

traits.label: What an instrument would record
traits.text: Blood flow at the spot rises slowly, from 0.39 to 0.44 of resting flow over the half minute around its release (the median of 12), as the latch lets go; nothing changes in the muscle's own activity. Before it, the region is under-perfused and quiet to the senses.

switch.x_label: attention and touch brought to the region (log)
switch.note: Clamped, the region is cut off from awareness and its prediction cannot update; bring enough awareness to it and the prediction lets go, and the latch after it.

layout.note: a few candidate places along the zone where the muscle's nerve enters it

traits.label: Felt from inside
traits.text: Its acid, sensitising milieu stirs the muscle's nerves: an ache felt from inside. A held, tender place, in 19 of 22 settings.

traits.label: Found by a finger
traits.text: A small firm nodule on a taut band, about the size measured by ultrasound (0.16 cm², sikdar2009). About 15 mm down, in the muscle. A finger can find it in 6 of 22 settings where knots hold; in the rest it lies below the edge of touch.
traits.cell: a small nodule on a band, often too faint
traits.depends: depends most on the fat beneath the skin, over the upper trapezius: likelier the lower it is

depends_on.label: the fat beneath the skin, over the upper trapezius

traits.label: Where
traits.text: In the muscle, along the zone where its nerve enters it: a few candidate places, not everywhere. They gather where stress is held most, in all 22 settings.
traits.cell: in muscle, where its nerve enters

traits.label: How many
traits.text: Candidate places along the innervation zone, a few in each muscle: 0.3 to the square centimetre. After a stressful moment about 4 hold in this 4 cm patch (0.2 to the square centimetre); in 10 of 32 settings none can hold at all. A body has a few hundred such places (300 taken as representative).
traits.depends: depends most on how steeply relaxation needs energy: likelier the higher it is

depends_on.label: how steeply relaxation needs energy

traits.label: How they form
traits.text: Stress raises endplate activity; the contraction squeezes its capillaries, and the starved sarcomeres cannot let go: an energy crisis. They build during a stressful moment, over a minute or two (the first after about 58 s), in all 22 settings.

traits.label: While stress lingers
traits.text: While the stress lingers they stay as they are, in all 22 settings.

traits.label: Pressed or rolled
traits.text: Rolling a quiet place brings none out, in all 32 settings: a brief press adds a little ischaemia, not enough to start a crisis where none is near.

traits.label: With moods
traits.text: Over an hour of moods they hold steady, in all 32 settings.

traits.label: To slow breathing
traits.text: Over thirty slow breaths some let go, in 12 of 22 settings; where they do, about 75% of them, most often at the bottom of the breath, as the in-breath begins (30% of releases), the typical one at breath 16; one within the first two breaths in 7 of 12 settings. Relaxation lowers endplate activity, and the breath's movement stretches the band.
traits.depends: depends most on pressure that stops flow in the muscle's capillaries: likelier the higher it is

depends_on.label: pressure that stops flow in the muscle's capillaries

traits.label: To attention, without touch
traits.text: With attention resting on the spot and no touch, the knot there lets go where the same breaths alone would not, or sooner, in 12 of 22 settings. Attention concentrates the breath's stretch at the spot. If attention could aim the breath's calming at one place (a hypothesis), it would in 7 of 22 settings.

traits.label: To subtle breaths, attending
traits.text: With subtle breaths, a third the size of a slow breath, and attention resting on the spot, the knot there lets go in 9 of 22 settings, after about 3 s; across the patch about 0% let go (with thirty slow breaths, 25%). Small breaths stretch the band little; the calm they bring lowers endplate activity a little.
traits.depends: depends most on how much a breath moves the tissue at a knot: likelier the higher it is

depends_on.label: how much a breath moves the tissue at a knot

traits.label: What a breath would have to do
traits.text: Whatever its pattern, a breath reaches this knot through endplate activity at the knot. No fall in it frees the typical knot, even to rest for a minute. A slow out-breath lowers it by about 15% for a few seconds, a subtle breath by 5%, minutes of slow breathing by about 28%, sustained. So one breath frees it in none of 22 settings. The energy crisis holds by its own squeezed capillaries: it needs pressure or stretch, not calm alone.

traits.label: Under a resting hand
traits.text: It lets go under the hand, in 14 of 22 settings, after about 18 s; as it lifts in 1 of 22 settings. Sustained pressure lengthens the contracture slowly, over the tens of seconds of pressure release.
traits.depends: depends most on pressure that stops flow in the muscle's capillaries: likelier the higher it is

depends_on.label: pressure that stops flow in the muscle's capillaries

traits.label: How it lets go
traits.text: The firmness goes over minutes; the tenderness fades over a minute or so. The contracture relaxes as energy returns.

traits.label: A spark
traits.text: A release fast enough twitches: the local twitch response. 254 of the 357 releases in the breathing and hand scenes came with one, in 8 of 22 settings.
traits.depends: depends most on how much a stretch loosens the contracture: likelier the higher it is

depends_on.label: how much a stretch loosens the contracture

traits.label: After one lets go
traits.text: When the knot at the spot lets go, others go with it within ten seconds in 8 of 17 settings (about 2); within ten minutes a new one holds nearby in 7 of 17 settings, and the same one holds again in 8 of 17 settings (the first return after about 7 s). Nothing here links one trigger point to another: the key point and its satellites are not in the patch yet.
traits.cell: one moves in nearby · it comes back

traits.label: Parents and children
traits.text: Nothing in this account links trigger points in trees: its key point and satellites are not modelled yet.

traits.label: Held for hours
traits.text: Its slow sustaining factors, over weeks, are not modelled yet.

traits.label: What an instrument would record
traits.text: Elastography through the pressing probe sees the nodule's contracture fall from 0.57 to 0.46 over the tens of seconds around its release (the median of 11), under the hand; a needle in it finds the endplate still active (3.0 times its typical level before, 3.1 after): the press lengthens the band, it does not quiet the endplate. Nothing changes in the skin.

switch.x_label: activity at the endplate (its own drive)
switch.note: Starved by its own contraction, a contracted band cannot relax until its drive falls below the band, or pressure or stretch loosens it.

layout.note: patches of the gliding layer between the fasciae, 5 mm across

traits.label: Felt from inside
traits.text: The layers stop gliding, so movement pulls on the fascia's nerve endings where they are stuck: an ache or a pull when moving, quiet when still. A held, tender place, in 28 of 32 settings.
traits.depends: depends most on how strongly movement pulling on a stuck patch strains the fascia's nerve endings (1: tender at the holding stress's movement): likelier the higher it is

depends_on.label: how strongly movement pulling on a stuck patch strains the fascia's nerve endings (1: tender at the holding stress's movement)

traits.label: Found by a finger
traits.text: Nothing firm for a finger to find: what changes is how the layers slide. A finger that slides the skin finds it held there, over a patch a centimetre or more across.
traits.cell: nothing firm; the skin does not slide

traits.label: Where
traits.text: In the gliding layer between the fasciae, wherever movement is least: broad patches, not points. They gather where stress is held most, in 25 of 32 settings.
traits.depends: depends most on how much stress stills the layer's movement (guarding): likelier the higher it is

depends_on.label: how much stress stills the layer's movement (guarding)

traits.label: How many
traits.text: Patches of the gliding layer, 5 mm across (64 representative); a knot is a connected region of stuck ones. After a stressful moment about 26 of them are stuck in this 4 cm patch, in about 2 connected regions (the largest about 6 cm²). The account counts tens to hundreds of such patches in a body, each centimetres across.

traits.label: How they form
traits.text: They are there before any stressful moment: a layer left still (a night) jams, and a day's movement frees it only where it moves enough. Left still, the layer rebuilds its structure and thickens; movement breaks it down again. Where stress stills the layer, it jams. A stressful moment adds new ones in 3 of 32 settings, the first after about 88 s.
traits.cell: over stillness; a stressful moment adds some

traits.label: While stress lingers
traits.text: While the stress lingers they stay as they are, in all 32 settings.

traits.label: Pressed or rolled
traits.text: Rolling a quiet place brings none out, in 31 of 32 settings: a roller shears the layer, which breaks its structure down: it frees, it does not make. In one setting it brings one out, which goes when it stops.

traits.label: With moods
traits.text: Over an hour of moods they hold steady, in 27 of 32 settings; some come and go in the rest.
traits.depends: depends most on how long a still patch of the gliding layer takes to rebuild its structure: likelier the higher it is

depends_on.label: how long a still patch of the gliding layer takes to rebuild its structure

traits.label: To slow breathing
traits.text: Over thirty slow breaths some let go, in 12 of 32 settings; where they do, about 6% of them, most early in the out-breath (54% of releases), the typical one at breath 16; one within the first two breaths in 1 of 12 settings. The breath's movement shears the layer a little, and its calm eases the guarding, so the layer moves more.

traits.label: To attention, without touch
traits.text: With attention resting on the spot and no touch, the knot there lets go where the same breaths alone would not, or sooner, in none of 32 settings. The account gives attention no route to the layer: attention alone changes nothing here.

traits.label: To subtle breaths, attending
traits.text: With subtle breaths, a third the size of a slow breath, and attention resting on the spot, the knot there lets go in 1 of 32 settings, after about 290 s; across the patch about 0% let go (with thirty slow breaths, 0%). Nothing here answers attention, and small breaths hardly move the layer.

traits.label: What a breath would have to do
traits.text: Whatever its pattern, a breath reaches this knot through the stress that stills the layer (its guarding). No fall in it frees the typical knot, even to rest for a minute. A slow out-breath lowers it by about 17% for a few seconds, a subtle breath by 6%, minutes of slow breathing by about 29%, sustained. So one breath frees it in none of 32 settings. A jammed patch gives way only when movement shears it past its band, and then slowly at first: calm helps only by letting the layer move.

traits.label: Under a resting hand
traits.text: Never while the hand still presses, in all 32 settings. It does not let go within the scene, in 31 of 32 settings. A resting hand warms the layer a little and does not slide it; warmth thins hyaluronan by about 2% a degree (cowman2015). If the hand worked the skin in small circles instead of resting (deep friction, the account's own way), it would let go under the hand in 13 of 32 settings, after about 21 s.
traits.cell: not within a minute (never under it)

traits.label: How it lets go
traits.text: Nothing firm to go; the tenderness fades over a minute or so. A jammed patch gives way slowly and then all at once, like an avalanche (coussot2002): the layers slide again.
traits.cell: tenderness fades over a minute or so

traits.label: A spark
traits.text: No spark: nothing in a layer that starts to slide makes one; the pull on its nerve endings eases.

traits.label: After one lets go
traits.text: When the knot at the spot lets go, others go with it within ten seconds in 2 of 4 settings (about 2); within ten minutes a new one holds nearby in none of 4 settings, and the same one holds again in none of 4 settings. Patches jam and give way on their own; only a shared cause, a change in movement or stress, moves several at once.

traits.label: Parents and children
traits.text: No trees: the layer's patches are not branches of one another. The fascial chains along which the account has densification travel are not modelled yet.

traits.label: Held for hours
traits.text: When its stress ends a knot lets go, however long it was held, in 21 of 32 settings. What decides it is whether ordinary movement, once the stress has gone, shears a jammed patch past its band.
traits.depends: depends most on how long a still patch of the gliding layer takes to rebuild its structure: likelier the lower it is

depends_on.label: how long a still patch of the gliding layer takes to rebuild its structure

traits.label: What an instrument would record
traits.text: Ultrasound that tracks the layers sliding over each other (as measured in the back, langevin2011) sees the sliding at the spot rise from 0.02 to 0.72 of a free layer's over the half minute around its release (the median of 13); the skin's flow and the muscle's activity do not change.

switch.x_label: the shear on the layer from movement (log)
switch.note: Left still, the layer builds until it jams; movement breaks it down. Across the band both hold: a jammed patch stays jammed under movement that keeps a fluid one fluid, and gives way only past the band, slowly and then all at once.

layout.note: nerves of the skin where they pierce the fascia, about 20 mm apart

traits.label: Felt from inside
traits.text: A sensitised nerve firing on its own: an ache or a burn at a fixed point, sometimes spreading along its branches. A held, tender place, in all 32 settings.
traits.cell: an ache at a fixed point

traits.label: Found by a finger
traits.text: Nothing firm for a finger to find: a nerve of the skin is a millimetre across. Pressed, the point is tender, and past a level it tingles along the nerve's branches.

traits.label: Where
traits.text: Only where a nerve of the skin pierces the fascia, beside the perforator it travels with: a few fixed points, about 20 mm apart here. They do not gather where stress is held, in all 32 settings: they sit at the nerves' piercings, wherever those are.

traits.label: How many
traits.text: Nerves of the skin where they pierce the fascia (4 in the patch): 0.2 to the square centimetre. After a stressful moment about 3 hold in this 4 cm patch (0.2 to the square centimetre). The account counts thousands in a body, about as many as the medium and major perforators.

traits.label: How they form
traits.text: Stress excites a sensitised nerve through the sympathetic drive, about fourteen seconds late (devor1994), and through the load of the muscle around it. They appear within seconds of a stressful moment (the first after about 11 s), in 17 of 32 settings.

traits.label: While stress lingers
traits.text: While the stress lingers they stay as they are, in all 32 settings.

traits.label: Pressed or rolled
traits.text: Rolling a quiet place brings none out, in all 32 settings: a roller presses what it passes; where no nerve pierces there, it excites nothing.

traits.label: With moods
traits.text: Over an hour of moods, knots come and go (some form and let go at least twice), in 30 of 32 settings.

traits.label: To slow breathing
traits.text: Over thirty slow breaths some let go, in 20 of 32 settings; where they do, about 67% of them, most late in the out-breath (56% of releases), the typical one at breath 20; one within the first two breaths in 1 of 20 settings. A slow breath eases the load around the nerve at once and the sympathetic drive about fourteen seconds later.
traits.depends: depends most on how far minutes of slow breathing lower stress: likelier the higher it is

depends_on.label: how far minutes of slow breathing lower stress

traits.label: To attention, without touch
traits.text: With attention resting on the spot and no touch, the knot there lets go where the same breaths alone would not, or sooner, in none of 32 settings. The account gives attention no route to the nerve: attention alone changes nothing here.

traits.label: To subtle breaths, attending
traits.text: With subtle breaths, a third the size of a slow breath, and attention resting on the spot, the knot there lets go in 1 of 32 settings, after about 186 s; across the patch about 0% let go (with thirty slow breaths, 25%). Nothing here answers attention; small breaths ease the drive a little.

traits.label: What a breath would have to do
traits.text: Whatever its pattern, a breath reaches this knot through the stress at the nerve (the muscle's load around it, and the sympathetic drive). To free the typical knot it must fall by about 88% of the holding stress for 8 s, or 38% for a minute; nothing shorter than 8 s frees it. A slow out-breath lowers it by about 17% for a few seconds, a subtle breath by 6%, minutes of slow breathing by about 30%, sustained. So one breath frees it in none of 17 settings. The sympathetic route answers only after about fourteen seconds (devor1994), so a calming has to last; the site itself stays sensitised for weeks (dilley2008).

traits.label: Under a resting hand
traits.text: It does not let go within the scene, in 25 of 32 settings; under the hand in 2 of 32 settings. Pressing a sensitised nerve excites it: it is felt more under the hand, and past a level it tingles along its branches. A hand's 20-80 mmHg is also more than slows the blood leaving a nerve (20-30 mmHg, rydevik1981).
traits.depends: depends most on how far minutes of slow breathing lower stress: likelier the lower it is

depends_on.label: how far minutes of slow breathing lower stress

traits.label: How it lets go
traits.text: Nothing firm to go; the tenderness fades within seconds. What goes is its firing: the site stays sensitised, and the knot is felt again, in the same place, when its drive returns.

traits.label: A spark
traits.text: No spark at a release. Pressed, a sensitised nerve tingles along its branches: a tingle of pressing, not of letting go.

traits.label: After one lets go
traits.text: When the knot at the spot lets go, others go with it within ten seconds in 6 of 17 settings (about 1); within ten minutes a new one holds nearby in none of 17 settings, and the same one holds again in 15 of 17 settings (the first return after about 12 s). Each site answers its own drive; a shared stress moves them together, and a knot comes back where it was, at the same nerve.

traits.label: Parents and children
traits.text: No trees of knots: a nerve's branches spread from its piercing, and pressing the piercing is felt along them.

traits.label: Held for hours
traits.text: When its stress ends a knot lets go, however long it was held, in all 32 settings. Its firing follows the stress within a minute; the site's sensitivity outlasts it by weeks (dilley2008), so the knot returns with the stress, in the same place.

traits.label: What an instrument would record
traits.text: A recording from the nerve would see its firing fall from 1.05 to 1.01 of the level felt as a knot over the half minute around its release (the median of 13), following the sympathetic drive about fourteen seconds late; a local anaesthetic at the point would silence it (as at entrapped nerves of the abdominal wall, boelens2013). The skin's flow and the muscle's activity do not change.

switch.x_label: stress at the nerve (the shared unit)
switch.note: No switch: a sensitised nerve is felt while its drive is above threshold, and not below it. The drive follows the stress at once through the muscle around it, and about fourteen seconds late through the sympathetic drive; the nerve's sensitivity lasts weeks.

layout.note: motor units' territories, 5-10 mm across, running along the fibres

traits.label: Felt from inside
traits.text: Its contraction and its metabolites are sensed by the muscle's own sensors: a clench or an ache, felt from inside. A held, tender place, in 30 of 32 settings.

traits.label: Found by a finger
traits.text: A firm band along the fibres, 5-10 mm wide and a few centimetres long: a motor unit's territory contracted. Overlapping units make it firmer. About 15 mm down, in the muscle. A finger can find it in all 32 settings where knots hold; in the rest it lies below the edge of touch.
traits.cell: a firm band along the fibres

traits.label: Where
traits.text: In the muscle, wherever its motor units lie: territories 5 mm apart and overlapping. They gather where stress is held most, in all 32 settings.

traits.label: How many
traits.text: Motor units whose territories lie under the patch (64 representative): 4.0 to the square centimetre. After a stressful moment about 18 hold in this 4 cm patch (1.1 to the square centimetre).

traits.label: How they form
traits.text: Stress recruits motor units; some latch on and keep firing after the stress eases, kept on by the metabolites of their own contraction. They build during a stressful moment, over a minute or two (the first after about 61 s), in 15 of 32 settings.

traits.label: While stress lingers
traits.text: While the stress lingers they stay as they are, in all 32 settings.

traits.label: Pressed or rolled
traits.text: Rolling a quiet place brings none out, in 28 of 32 settings: the roller excites the units it presses, but where the drive is far below their threshold none latches. In the rest it brings one out, which stays after it stops in all 4 settings.
traits.depends: depends most on how far a firing unit squeezes its own supply: likelier the lower it is

depends_on.label: how far a firing unit squeezes its own supply

traits.label: With moods
traits.text: Over an hour of moods, knots come and go (some form and let go at least twice), in all 32 settings.

traits.label: To slow breathing
traits.text: Over thirty slow breaths some let go, in 17 of 32 settings; where they do, about 14% of them, most often at the bottom of the breath, as the in-breath begins (49% of releases), the typical one at breath 8; one within the first two breaths in 16 of 17 settings. The breath lowers the descending drive and the monoamines that deepen the latch.

traits.label: To attention, without touch
traits.text: With attention resting on the spot and no touch, the knot there lets go where the same breaths alone would not, or sooner, in 16 of 32 settings. Attention at a place inhibits its units.
traits.depends: depends most on how far minutes of slow breathing lower stress: likelier the higher it is

depends_on.label: how far minutes of slow breathing lower stress

traits.label: To subtle breaths, attending
traits.text: With subtle breaths, a third the size of a slow breath, and attention resting on the spot, the knot there lets go in 6 of 32 settings, after about 11 s; across the patch about 0% let go (with thirty slow breaths, 5%). Attention inhibits the units at the spot whatever the breath's size; the breath itself adds little.
traits.depends: depends most on the loop: how strongly a unit's own metabolites drive it: likelier the lower it is

depends_on.label: the loop: how strongly a unit's own metabolites drive it

traits.label: What a breath would have to do
traits.text: Whatever its pattern, a breath reaches this knot through the unit's input (a fall in drive, or inhibition, such as attention's). To free the typical knot it must fall by about 93% of the holding stress for 8 s, or 88% for a minute; nothing shorter than 8 s frees it. A slow out-breath lowers it by about 15% for a few seconds, a subtle breath by 5%, minutes of slow breathing by about 29%, sustained. So one breath frees it in none of 32 settings. The latch holds a unit on at a small share of the input that recruited it: the input must fall far below that.

traits.label: Under a resting hand
traits.text: It lets go under the hand, in 22 of 32 settings, after about 10 s. A held hand excites the units under it for a moment and then inhibits them (which a hand does is not known; the other variant follows). If a held hand only excited the units under it, it would let go under the hand in 2 of 32 settings.
traits.depends: depends most on how fast that warm-up builds and fades: likelier the lower it is

depends_on.label: how fast that warm-up builds and fades

traits.label: How it lets go
traits.text: The firmness goes at once; the tenderness fades over minutes. The unit falls silent and its fibres relax: an unclenching.

traits.label: A spark
traits.text: No tingle at a release: nothing in a motor unit falling silent makes one.

traits.label: After one lets go
traits.text: When the knot at the spot lets go, others go with it within ten seconds in all 22 settings (about 6); within ten minutes a new one holds nearby in 21 of 22 settings, and the same one holds again in 9 of 22 settings (the first return after about 4 s). Neighbouring units share the metabolites' drive, so a latched unit can hand its load to one nearby.
traits.cell: others go with it · one moves in nearby · it comes back

traits.label: Parents and children
traits.text: Motor units are not arranged in trees: neighbours share only their metabolites' drive.

traits.label: Held for hours
traits.text: When its stress ends a knot lets go, however long it was held, in all 32 settings.

traits.label: What an instrument would record
traits.text: Surface EMG that picks out single motor units sees the knot's unit fall silent at the moment it lets go (7 units firing under the electrode before, 0 after, the median of 16 releases), and elastography sees the firmness at the spot fall from 8.9 to 6.3 times the edge of touch. The skin's flow does not change.

switch.x_label: input to the motor neuron (share of its threshold)
switch.note: Recruited at its threshold, a unit keeps firing down to a small share of it (its persistent currents), while serotonin and noradrenaline last.

layout.note: places on the body map, about 10 mm apart

traits.label: Felt from inside
traits.text: Felt from inside is all it is: a place the nervous system turns up. A held, tender place, in all 32 settings.

traits.label: Found by a finger
traits.text: Nothing firm for a finger to find: nothing in the tissue changes. What a finger meets is an ordinary structure, felt more.

traits.label: Where
traits.text: Wherever the body map tells places apart, about 10 mm on the back: broad and soft-edged. They do not gather where stress is held, in 29 of 32 settings: they sit where ordinary input happens to be loudest, and arousal raises every place at once.

traits.label: How many
traits.text: Places on the body map, about 10 mm apart: 1.0 to the square centimetre. After a stressful moment about 6 hold in this 4 cm patch (0.4 to the square centimetre).

traits.label: How they form
traits.text: Arousal turns up what is felt, most where stress is held and the muscles guard. They appear within seconds of a stressful moment (the first after about 1 s), in all 32 settings. Some places are felt as knots even at rest, before any stress, in 11 of 32 settings.

traits.label: While stress lingers
traits.text: While the stress lingers they stay as they are, in 29 of 32 settings.

traits.label: Pressed or rolled
traits.text: Rolling a quiet place brings none out, in 30 of 32 settings: a press is felt while it lasts. In the rest it brings one out, which stays after it stops in 1 of 2 settings.

traits.label: With moods
traits.text: Over an hour of moods they hold steady, in 18 of 32 settings; some come and go in the rest.

traits.label: To slow breathing
traits.text: Over thirty slow breaths some let go, in 14 of 32 settings; where they do, about 57% of them, most often early in the out-breath (40% of releases), the typical one at breath 12; one within the first two breaths in 4 of 14 settings. A slow breath eases arousal and is felt as safety; the in-breath is felt a little less.

traits.label: To attention, without touch
traits.text: With attention resting on the spot and no touch, the knot there lets go where the same breaths alone would not, or sooner, in 15 of 32 settings. Attention first turns up what is felt there, then, with the breath, quiets it.
traits.depends: depends most on how uneven ordinary input is from place to place: likelier the lower it is

depends_on.label: how uneven ordinary input is from place to place

traits.label: To subtle breaths, attending
traits.text: With subtle breaths, a third the size of a slow breath, and attention resting on the spot, the knot there lets go in 13 of 32 settings, after about 300 s; across the patch about 15% let go (with thirty slow breaths, 0%). Attention with safety quiets a place whatever the breath's size.
traits.depends: depends most on how fast attention with safety quiets a place: likelier the lower it is

depends_on.label: how fast attention with safety quiets a place

traits.label: What a breath would have to do
traits.text: Whatever its pattern, a breath reaches this knot through arousal, everywhere at once (perception has no drive of its own at a place). No fall in it frees the typical knot, even to rest for a minute; the easiest quarter need about 99% of the holding stress taken away for 16 s. A slow out-breath lowers it by about 17% for a few seconds, a subtle breath by 6%, minutes of slow breathing by about 28%, sustained. So one breath frees it in none of 32 settings. What is felt follows arousal and attention; sensitisation keeps a place loud after arousal falls.

traits.label: Under a resting hand
traits.text: Never while the hand still presses, in all 32 settings. It does not let go within the scene, in 25 of 32 settings; as it lifts in 7 of 32 settings. A hand adds input and draws attention: the place is felt more under it.
traits.cell: not within a minute (never under it)

traits.label: How it lets go
traits.text: Nothing firm to go; the tenderness fades at once. What goes is what is felt.

traits.label: A spark
traits.text: No tingle at a release: its tingling comes only from overbreathing, in the hands, face and trunk at once.

traits.label: After one lets go
traits.text: When the knot at the spot lets go, others go with it within ten seconds in 7 of 8 settings (about 1); within ten minutes a new one holds nearby in none of 8 settings, and the same one holds again in 1 of 8 settings (the first return after about 64 s). Attention moves to the next loudest place, and the loudest knot quiets the others.

traits.label: Parents and children
traits.text: No trees: places on the body map are not branches of one another.

traits.label: Held for hours
traits.text: When its stress ends a knot lets go, however long it was held, in 20 of 32 settings.
traits.depends: depends most on how close ordinary input is to being felt as a knot: likelier the lower it is

depends_on.label: how close ordinary input is to being felt as a knot

traits.label: What an instrument would record
traits.text: Nothing in the tissue changes: skin flow, muscle activity and stiffness stay as they were. Only the report changes: what is felt at the spot falls from 2.43 to 0.75 of the level felt as a knot (the median of 7 releases).

switch.x_label: how loudly the place is felt (1: felt as a knot)
switch.note: Felt as a knot once it is loud enough, and still felt until it falls a little lower: a narrow band, in the nervous system alone.
